code.label: Code & Runtime
code.executiveSummary: The API has two authorization gaps on admin routes. The web app re-renders the dashboard on every websocket tick.

findings.title: Guard admin export route
findings.description: `GET /admin/export` has no `@Roles('admin')` guard; any session can download all bookings.
findings.recommendation: Add the guard and an e2e test for a non-admin session.

findings.title: Check tenant id on booking updates
findings.description: The update path trusts the tenant id from the body.

findings.title: Throttle dashboard updates
findings.description: Every websocket tick (~20/s) re-renders the whole tree.
findings.recommendation: Batch into `requestAnimationFrame` and memoize the chart.

findings.title: Export prop types from the UI kit
